news.title: Prestige Estates acquires Gloind Vintage Infra at ₹519 crore enterprise value
news.para: Prestige Retail Ventures has successfully concluded the acquisition of Gloind Vintage Infra, valuing the enterprise at approximately ₹519 crore. The venture involved acquiring 100% equity of Gloind for ₹5 lakh, granting PRVL complete authority. This move not only bolsters their holdings but also brings Tarun Realtors, a wholly owned subsidiary of Gloind, under Prestige Estates Projects’ expanding portfolio.

news.title: Haryana cabinet approves land pooling policy-2026; landowners to get 50% of saleable area
news.para: Haryana's Cabinet has greenlit the Land Pooling Policy-2026, updating the previous Land Pooling Policy-2022. This new policy allows landowners to keep 50 percent of the project's saleable area according to the approved layout. Moreover, they will receive Rs 1 lakh per acre annually for four years following the sale deed registration.

news.title: Kolte-Patil Developers posts ₹5.70 crore net profit in Q2 FY27
news.para: Kolte-Patil Developers showcased impressive financial growth with a consolidated net profit of ₹5.70 crore for Q2 FY27. The company saw its total income soar to ₹351.51 crore, a significant jump from ₹161.75 crore. Record pre-sales of ₹1,019 crore marked a remarkable 52 percent increase year-on-year. For H1 FY27, the total income hit ₹1,288.13 crore, rising from ₹258.56 crore in the last fiscal year, signaling a robust performance.

news.title: IndiQube Spaces’ net loss narrows 80% to ₹5.86 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: In the financial report for the quarter ending September 30, 2026, IndiQube Spaces disclosed a net loss after tax of ₹5.86 crore. Despite this loss, total income surged to ₹492.16 crore, up from ₹366.59 crore compared to the same period last year. The company boasts 10.86 million square feet of managed space across 138 centres, serving 884 clients, revealing a positive trend in its financial performance for FY27.

news.title: Hyderabad: NCLT brings Madhapur land into Butta Infra liquidation estate
news.para: A significant piece of real estate located in Khanamet, Hyderabad, has been designated as part of the liquidation estate belonging to Butta Infrastructure. This decision stems from a ruling issued by the National Company Law Tribunal, which concluded that LIC Housing Finance did not adequately demonstrate its attempts at asset recovery.

news.title: Bagmane Prime Office REIT reports NOI of ₹684.39 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: For Q2 FY27, Bagmane Prime Office REIT reported an impressive net operating income of ₹684.39 crore, showcasing a remarkable 99 percent occupancy across its portfolio. The quarter also saw gross leasing figures hit around 1.2 million sq. ft., with several reputable firms signing new leases. The total asset value neared ₹41,600 crore, coupled with a commendably low debt-to-asset ratio. Distributions per unit reached ₹1.55, primarily from dividends.

news.title: Ajmera Realty’s net profit rises 48% to ₹45.01 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: In Q2 FY27, Ajmera Realty & Infra India declared a remarkable 48.2 percent rise in net profit after tax. The firm's total income surged by 44.5 percent year-over-year. Despite this financial upswing, sales witnessed a notable decline, with collections down by 14 percent. However, the company made strides in reducing its debt by ₹34 crore, which positively impacted its debt-to-equity ratio.

news.title: Awfis Space Solutions’ net profit rises 93% to ₹30.80 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: Awfis Space Solutions has showcased remarkable growth with a net profit surge to ₹30.80 crore for Q2 FY27, underpinned by robust total income rising to ₹464.29 crore. The company's expansion, featuring six new centres, has brought its total to 254, signifying strong demand in the co-working sector. This year, Awfis aspires for a steady cash EBITDA between ₹190-200 crore, aiming to boost occupancy rates across all locations.

news.title: Pioneer Urban to invest over ₹3,500 crore in Gurugram luxury housing project
news.para: Pioneer Urban plans to invest more than ₹3,500 crore in Alura, a 3.4 million sq ft serviced residences project in Sector 62, Gurugram. The project, comprising about 250 homes, is expected to generate sales of over ₹9,000 crore, with apartment prices ranging from ₹28 crore to ₹70 crore.

news.title: Arkade Developers acquires Bhandup land-owning company for ₹146 crore
news.para: Arkade Developers has agreed to acquire 100% of Woollen and Textile Industries for ₹146 crore, giving it access to a 14,363.60 sq metre land parcel in Bhandup West, Mumbai. The company plans a residential development on the site with an estimated GDV of ₹1,800 crore.

news.title: Tamil Nadu housing board steps out of old blocks, decides to build gated communities in Chennai
news.para: The Tamil Nadu Housing Board plans to launch a project for the construction of 416 residential flats at three strategic sites in Chennai. This ambitious venture aims to provide high-income, rental, and mixed-income housing while optimizing land utilization. The flats will incorporate essential amenities, community spaces, and innovative building management systems, complete with effective parking solutions designed by leading architectural firms to enhance spatial and resource efficiency.

news.title: About 600 dilapidated housing board homes in Aishbagh to be demolished on November 14
news.para: Residents of the 600 dilapidated EWS houses in Aishbagh face a significant deadline. They must vacate their homes by November 13 to make way for a demolition drive by the Madhya Pradesh Housing Board, scheduled for November 14. Only those who are the original legal allottees are eligible for rental assistance and will be provided larger new flats, while unauthorized occupants will be evicted without any benefits.

news.title: Arbour bets on Mumbai 3.0, commits ₹85 crore to Svaasa, a Sensation Fortune Group project in Karjat
news.para: As the Panvel-Karjat rail corridor nears completion, institutional capital backs a 54.5-acre plotted development on one of Karjat's lakefronts

news.title: Rubics Realty launches BeauMontè Tower C, setting a new benchmark for premium living in Sion
news.para: The 41-storey spire brings together large-format residences, seven homes per floor, 2.7 acres of recreational space and 50+ lifestyle amenities in the heart of central Mumbai.

news.title: NBCC signs ₹2,000 crore Patna redevelopment MoUs; Avenue Towers e-auction fetches ₹5,191 crore
news.para: NBCC has signed MoUs with the Bihar government for four redevelopment projects in Patna with an estimated project cost of ₹2,000 crore and potential sale and lease proceeds of about ₹5,152 crore. Separately, the company realised ₹5,191 crore through an e-auction of residential units in New Delhi and opened a branch office in Australia.

news.title: Property owners in Bengaluru face delay in upgrading from B-khata to A-khata due to tech glitches
news.para: In Greater Bengaluru, a noteworthy number of property owners face considerable delays in upgrading from B-khata to A-khata due to technical glitches in the recently implemented e-Aasthi 2.0 software, which hinders document uploads. This has made it increasingly challenging to access essential civic services, conduct transactions, and secure bank loans.

news.title: Sri Lotus Developers promoter to sell up to 5.89% stake through OFS
news.para: Sri Lotus Developers and Realty promoter Anand Kamalnayan Pandit proposes to sell up to 2.88 crore shares, representing 5.89% of the company’s paid-up equity capital, through an offer for sale. The base offer comprises a 4.87% stake, with an additional 1.02% oversubscription option.

news.title: Sebi allows REITs, InvITs to issue depository receipts
news.para: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) has authorized the issuance of Depository Receipts for Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs) and Infrastructure Investment Trusts (InvITs) to increase foreign investment. This new framework allows these investment vehicles to issue fresh units for DRs, mandatory for non-Indian residents, and enforces strict compliance with prior unitholder approval as well as pricing and reporting guidelines.

news.title: Brookfield India REIT’s NOI rises 51% to ₹767.2 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: In Q2 FY27, Brookfield India Real Estate Trust achieved a remarkable 51 percent growth in net operating income. Total income soared by over 52 percent year-on-year, and the REIT declared distributions of ₹5.70 per unit. With 1.6 million square feet leased and a solid occupancy rate of 93 percent, the first half of FY27 marked a substantial 54 percent rise in operating lease rentals compared to last year.

news.title: Mindspace Business Parks REIT’s NOI rises 32% to ₹836 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: In Q2 FY27, Mindspace Business Parks REIT achieved 31.9 percent rise in net operating income, showcasing its robust financial health. The total income reached ₹1,028.43 crore, marking a 30.1 percent increase year-on-year. Additionally, the net profit saw a jump to ₹479.18 crore. The gross leasing activity was notable, covering around 1.6 million sq ft.
